description: Every inbound route of the anonymous usage statistics module (prefix /api/v1). health answers signed-in users only; every other route answers the operator of the installation only (SUPER_ADMIN_ACCOUNT_UID, EVER_OPERATOR_UIDS) and 404 to anyone else. With EVER_STATS_ENABLED=false none of them exists.

routes.purpose: Whether the module is loaded (the portal shows the Statistics page only then)
State and reason, next and last send, instance id, key id, country, install source
What is sent: the report built now, checked, never sent or stored
The last 12 reports: the exact bytes, date, status and HTTP answer
Send now (409 while switched off, once per 10 minutes)
The operator's switch (409 cloud_managed on Ever Cloud)
Recount users, workspaces, teams and stored bytes
A new instance id and statistics key; the report history is cleared
